name: speed up
does: Step the walking speed up one notch, without moving the stick.

name: slow down
does: Step the walking speed down one notch, without moving the stick.

name: e-stop
does: Cut all twelve servos at once, in hardware, whatever the policy is asking for.

name: follow me
does: Walk towards whoever is holding the controller and hold a set distance.

name: stairs
does: Switch to the gait for going up and down steps.

name: rough ground
does: Switch to the gait for uneven ground, where a foot can land anywhere.

name: look up and down
does: Pitch the whole body to aim it up or down, with the feet staying put.
